issue.title: Provide upgrade guide for Mockito 2.0
issue.body:
The upgrade guide should depict all breaking changes since 1.10.19 as well as new functionality.
- http://abi-laboratory.pro/java/tracker/compat_report/mockito/1.10.19/2.0.79-beta/2afce/bin_compat_report.html lists all changes to the public API.
- Remove new tag from changes introduced in 1.10, several sections starting at http://site.mockito.org/mockito/docs/current/org/mockito/Mockito.html#29
- The changelog at https://github.com/mockito/mockito/blob/master/doc/release-notes/official.md

The guide should help developers estimate the amount of effort required to update to Mockito 2.0. If we provide enough tools to ease the process, Mockito 2.0 adoption will be faster.
